theorem PIntegrated.arithmetic_kernel_trace_source_limit.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_4 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_5 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_6 : SFinite mu] [inst_7 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2)
  (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
  have hh' := ⋯;
  have hc' := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h hh' hc';
  let V := JThetaAttachment.sourceSpan K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have Theta := OArithmeticClosure.arithmeticSourceMap K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 Theta;
  have S := (JThetaAttachment.thetaClosure K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑((E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae mu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) *
          ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂mu) ∧
    (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
        Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) mu ∧
          ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu =
              Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A) ∧
            Filter.Tendsto
              (fun n =>
                ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  (DReview.physicalBand K n).indicator (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) x ∂mu)
              Filter.atTop (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)))) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) Filter.atTop (nhds (A F - S (A F))) :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
    [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] addHaar mu
    [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] chi a l r s hlr hs phi hh hc q F =>
  id
    (let A :=
      PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q)
        (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).left (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).right;
    let V := JThetaAttachment.sourceSpan K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
    have ht :=
      DSourceKernel.source_kernel_trace_global_connection mu
        (fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x))
        (fun x =>
          id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => 0 < _a)
                  (PIntervalConvolution.interval_halfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) hlr)))
              (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos ((l + r) / 2 * Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x))
                (Masullo.GenuineMellinJet.nativeHalfWeight_pos ((r - l) / 2) s
                  (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)))))
        0 0 (OArithmeticClosure.arithmeticSourceMap K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s) A F;
    ⟨ht.left,
      ⟨fun T =>
        have hd := ht.right.left T;
        ⟨hd.left,
          ⟨hd.right,
            have hl :=
              DReview.originalHaar_physical_limit K mu
                (fun x =>
                  DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu
                    (fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x))
                    (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
                      (OArithmeticClosure.arithmeticSourceMap K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s) T)
                    A x x)
                hd.left;
            Eq.mp
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  Filter.Tendsto
                    (fun n =>
                      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                        (DReview.physicalBand K n).indicator
                          (fun x =>
                            DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu
                              (fun x =>
                                PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x))
                              (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
                                (OArithmeticClosure.arithmeticSourceMap K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2)
                                  s)
                                T)
                              A x x)
                          x ∂mu)
                    Filter.atTop (nhds _a))
                hd.right)
              hl⟩⟩,
        have hp := OArithmeticClosure.arithmetic_sourceProjection_eq K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
        have hlim := ht.right.right;
        Eq.mp
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              Filter.Tendsto
                (fun T =>
                  A F -
                    (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
                          (OArithmeticClosure.arithmeticSourceMap K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s)
                          T).starProjection
                      (A F))
                Filter.atTop (nhds (A F - _a (A F))))
            hp)
          hlim⟩⟩)

theorem HOperatorTrace.source_complement_basis_factor.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H] (S : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_3 : S.HasOrthogonalProjection]
  {ι : Type u_2} (e : HilbertBasis ι ℂ ↥Sᗮ) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (x : H),
  HasSum (fun i => ⟪(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) ↑(e i), x⟫_ℂ • ↑(e i)) (((1 - S.starProjection).comp A) x) :=
fun {H} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] S [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] {ι} e A x =>
  id
    (Eq.mp
      (congrArg (fun x_1 => HasSum (fun i => ⟪(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) ↑(e i), x⟫_ℂ • ↑(e i)) x_1)
        (Submodule.starProjection_orthogonal_val (A x)))
      (HOperatorTrace.projected_basis_factor Sᗮ e A x))

  id fun F =>
    HOperatorTrace.source_complement_basis_factor
      (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s)
      (Masullo.TraceClass.stdHilbertBasis ℂ
        ↥(JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s)ᗮ)
      (PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q)
        (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).left (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).right)
      F
